purpose: Verify that verifier producer exceptions, including crashes after partial verifier-side work, persist only BLOCKED evidence and cannot authorize a protected effect.

expected.safe_condition: A verifier producer that raises before returning a valid VerifierResult must persist VERIFIER_UNAVAILABLE/BLOCKED evidence and never authorize the protected effect, even if the producer performed partial work before crashing; a completed valid verifier control may proceed.

limits: This test measures MGnarf v1.70 handling of ordinary Python Exception failures from verifier producers at the exact target commit.
It does not roll back verifier-side external effects and does not claim crash consistency for the verifier's own external systems.
